items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: I have one brother who is, uh, seven years younger than I am. His name is Carl Jones.

ctx.x: Yeah, well I can remember JMR and I would go in there to see him. He did his own commercials and played records. That's right. And I'd lend him some of my records from time to time. Uh-huh. I was working for Mercury Records, you know. Or William B. Allen, who was the distributor. Uh-huh. I could sort of check those dates out sometime, but I imagine there was plenty of documentation. Do you have any brothers and sisters?

I have one brother who is, uh, seven years younger than I am. His name is Carl Jones. And he is a colonel in the United States Army, stationed in the Pentagon. Just about to retire. He's got about another year of service to go. And, uh, he'll be retiring at the ripe old age of about 40, full colonel's pay. And, uh, he has really no interest in music at all. He never did, uh, that I can remember, display any, uh, musical traits. He was a very, very intelligent boy, young man. And, uh, always did wonderfully in…
Did you have a phonograph at home? I think I actually read it.
